techniques.name: Few-Shot Neural Differentiable Simulator (real-to-sim rigid-contact)
techniques.capability_enabled: Calibrates analytical rigid-body simulators from a small amount of real-world data, then trains a mesh-based GNN that models rigid-body forward dynamics with surrogate collision gradients and full differentiability for real-to-sim contact modeling.
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link surfaced in WebSearch result blocks; arxiv abstract/page not retrievable via fetch.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The method introduces a mesh-based GNN that implicitly models rigid-body forward dynamics and derives surrogate gradients for collision detection, achieving full differentiability.

techniques.name: Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN)
techniques.capability_enabled: Overcomes spectral bias in Hamiltonian NNs for multi-timescale dynamics by decomposing the Hamiltonian into fast/slow modes via multiple networks trained at distinct timescales; extends to PDEs via state- and boundary-conditioned symplectic operators, improving long-horizon extrapolation.
techniques.code_evidence: No GitHub/HF/code-available statement appeared in WebSearch result blocks.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The paper introduces the Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN), which parameterizes the system Hamiltonian using multiple networks, each governed by Hamiltonian dynamics and trained on data sampled at distinct timescales.

techniques.name: ATLAS-NN (Adaptive Transfer Learnable Symplectic-aware Neural Network)
techniques.capability_enabled: Augments the HNN architecture with a learnable temporal-scaling (nonlinear time-reparameterization) mechanism plus a two-stage transfer-learning strategy to model long-time Hamiltonian dynamics with multiscale structure and rapid nonlinear transitions.
techniques.code_evidence: No code repository information returned in WebSearch result blocks.
techniques.verbatim_quote: ATLAS-NN is a framework that augments the HNN architecture with a learnable temporal scaling mechanism that parametrize a nonlinear mapping of time, automatically adapting to the system's intrinsic complexity.

techniques.name: Symplectic Neural Operator (SNO)
techniques.capability_enabled: A neural operator architecture that preserves the symplectic structure intrinsic to Hamiltonian PDEs, with theoretical symplecticity characterization and a long-term stability result; gives improved energy behavior over non-structure-preserving neural operators for infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems.
techniques.code_evidence: WebSearch surfaced only an UNRELATED older repo (SpaceAbleOrg/symplectic-hnn, the 2023 'Symplectic Learning for HNNs' paper); no code link for this 2605 paper.
techniques.verbatim_quote: Numerical experiments on canonical Hamiltonian PDEs show that SNOs exhibit improved energy behavior compared with non-structure-preserving neural operators.

techniques.name: NEMF (Neural Electromagnetic Fields for material parameter reconstruction)
techniques.capability_enabled: Neural-field framework for dense, non-invasive physical inversion: uses image-derived geometry as an anchor and a differentiable layer with physical reflection models to learn a continuous, spatially-varying field of material parameters (permittivity, conductivity) for functional digital twins.
techniques.code_evidence: No code/GitHub/HF statement appeared in WebSearch result blocks for this paper.
techniques.verbatim_quote: Guided by ambient RF signals and a differentiable layer incorporating physical reflection models, it learns to explicitly output a continuous, spatially-varying field of the scene's underlying material parameters.
